HEADLINE: We wish to inform you that the Board of Directors of Panasonic Energy India Co. Ltd., at its meeting held today, has accorded its approval for the  transfer/assignment of the leasehold ....
MORE:
We wish to inform you that the Board of Directors of Panasonic Energy India Co. Ltd., at its meeting held today, has accorded its approval for the  transfer/assignment of the leasehold rights in the GIDC Industrial Plot situated at Makarpura, Vadodara - 390010, in favour of the identified buyer, subject to obtaining all requisite approvals, permissions, consents, sanctions and No Objection Certificates from GIDC and other applicable authorities, and subject to compliance with the terms and conditions of the definitive agreements. 

The Company shall be entitled to terminate the transaction in accordance with the terms of the definitive agreements in the event of any default, breach or non-fulfilment of the conditions thereunder by the buyer.

The property does not qualify as an "undertaking" under Section 180(1)(a) of the Companies Act, 2013; therefore, shareholder approval is not required on this ground.
